info.title: Payload Rail API
info.description: Canonical public API for the Payload Rail (https://payload-rail.fly.dev): Veyline economic-control subscriptions, callx402 paid on-demand actions, RevRule revenue rules, and purchases. Product isolation is enforced: Veyline, callx402, and RevRule credentials are product-bound. This document describes every legitimate public/customer/agent-callable operation. Internal admin and operational endpoints are intentionally excluded.

tags.name: callx402
tags.description: Paid on-demand x402 assistance actions. Pay per action; never requires a Veyline subscription.

tags.name: Veyline
tags.description: Ongoing subscription infrastructure for continuous economic control. Requires Veyline product credential.

tags.name: Enterprise
tags.description: Enterprise-tier org administration. Requires enterprise entitlement + veyline:admin scope.

tags.name: RevRule
tags.description: Economic rule execution. Separate product; never a mandatory dependency of Veyline.
